content.title: Navigate dashboard contexts
content.description: An investment professional moves among the dashboard’s portfolio, analytics, research, and system contexts through the fixed sidebar, changes the active state and page heading without routing to another page or URL, and stays within the single-page terminal while contextual content updates in place.
content.summary: Switch dashboard context within the single-page workspace
content.value: Keeps navigation fast and contained while exposing all major dashboard areas from one shell.
criteria: Navigation stays within one page: there is no application routing, separate dashboard pages, URL navigation, or multi-page workflow.
Primary navigation items are Overview, Portfolio, Markets, Watchlist, and Transactions.
Analytics items are Performance, Risk, Attribution, and Scenarios.
Research items are Research Notes, Saved Views, and Reports.
System items are Alerts and Data Health.
Overview is selected by default, and clicking a sidebar item changes active state and contextual page heading without routing away.
